en.name: English
en.title: Custom WordPress, apps and smart e-commerce for {location}
en.intro: We design and build efficient digital products for organisations serving {location}. Our priorities: maintainable WordPress plugins, practical web apps and WooCommerce solutions with a clear commercial purpose.
en.localText: For {sector} in {location}, a project is useful when it improves {workflow}. We start with content, customers and operating constraints before selecting the stack.
en.approachText: Example starting point for a {location} brief — not a claim of a completed local client project:
en.pluginsText: Gutenberg blocks, ACF field groups, integrations, back-office controls, lean PHP and thoughtful editor UX. Built around your workflow rather than plugin overload.
en.appsText: React and PHP dashboards, portals, calculators, reporting, booking, roles, integrations and mobile-first interactions for real operations.
en.ecommerceText: Complex catalogues, product variations, B2B pricing, delivery logic, conversion-oriented checkout and dependable performance.
en.d1: A clear scope, content map and measurable customer journey
en.d2: Fast, accessible pages and mobile-ready interfaces
en.d3: Editable components, testing and a handover plan
en.faq1: Does DigitalPulse need an office in {location} to take a project?
en.fa1: No. Projects can be scoped, designed, developed and supported remotely. In-person arrangements depend on the project and availability; this page does not represent a local branch address.
en.faq2: Can you extend an existing WordPress or WooCommerce site?
en.fa2: Yes. We can review a current codebase, improve performance and maintainability, develop a targeted plugin or integration, or plan a careful migration without unnecessary rewrites.
en.ctaText: Tell us your current platform, the user problem and what success looks like. We can propose the smallest reliable solution.
en.remote: Remote-first project delivery — no claim of a physical office in this location.
en.hubTitle: WordPress, web apps and e-commerce across the UK, Baltics and Nordics
en.hubDesc: Explore places and markets where DigitalPulse can discuss remote-first custom WordPress plugin, web app and WooCommerce projects. Every page highlights a relevant workflow, not a claimed local office.

sv.pluginsText: Gutenberg-block, ACF-fält, integrationer och enkla administrationsverktyg utan onödiga tillägg.
sv.appsText: React/PHP-paneler, portaler, kalkylatorer, bokningar, rapporter och mobilanpassade integrationer.
sv.ecommerceText: Avancerade kataloger, varianter, B2B-priser, leveransregler, smidig kassa och prestanda.
sv.d1: Tydlig omfattning, innehållsstruktur och mätbar kundresa
sv.fa1: Nej. Vi arbetar på distans. Fysiska möten planeras separat; den här sidan innebär inte ett lokalt kontor.
sv.faq2: Kan ni förbättra en befintlig WordPress eller WooCommerce?
sv.fa2: Ja. Vi granskar kod och prestanda och bygger riktade tillägg eller integrationer utan onödig ombyggnad.
sv.ctaText: Beskriv er plattform, användarnas behov och målet. Vi föreslår en pålitlig lösning.
sv.remote: Distansleverans; inget påstående om lokalt kontor.
sv.hubTitle: WordPress, webbappar och e-handel i Storbritannien, Baltikum och Norden
sv.hubDesc: Utforska marknader för WordPress-tillägg, webbappar och WooCommerce på distans. Områdessidorna visar inte kontorsadresser.

fi.title: WordPress-lisäosat, verkkosovellukset ja älykäs verkkokauppa: {location}
fi.intro: Digitaalinen kehitys — {location}: räätälöidyt WordPress-lisäosat, PHP/React-verkkosovellukset ja nopeat WooCommerce-kaupat. Etäyhteistyössä korostuvat käytettävyys ja ylläpidettävyys.
fi.localText: {location} — toimiala: {sector}. Suunnittelemme ratkaisuja, jotka parantavat {workflow}. Aloitamme käyttäjien tarpeista ja työprosesseista.
fi.approachText: Esimerkkihanke alueelle {location}; se ei ole väite toteutetusta paikallisesta asiakasprojektista:
fi.pluginsText: Gutenberg-lohkot, ACF-kentät, integraatiot ja kevyet hallintatyökalut ilman turhia lisäosia.
fi.appsText: React/PHP-hallintapaneelit, portaalit, laskurit, varaukset, raportit ja mobiiliratkaisut.
fi.ecommerceText: Laajat tuoteluettelot, variaatiot, B2B-hinnat, toimitusehdot, maksaminen ja suorituskyky.
fi.d1: Selkeät tavoitteet, sisältörakenne ja mitattava asiakaspolku
fi.fa1: Ei. Projektit voidaan hoitaa etänä. Tapaamisista sovitaan erikseen; sivu ei väitä paikallista toimistoa.
fi.faq2: Voitteko parantaa olemassa olevaa WordPress- tai WooCommerce-sivustoa?
fi.fa2: Kyllä. Tarkistamme koodin ja nopeuden ja toteutamme kohdennetut lisäosat tai integraatiot ilman turhaa uudelleenkirjoitusta.
fi.ctaText: Kerro alustasta, käyttäjien tarpeista ja tavoitteesta. Ehdotamme kestävää ratkaisua.

is.title: WordPress-viðbætur, veföpp og snjöll netverslun fyrir {location}
is.intro: Stafræn þróun — {location}: sérsniðnar WordPress-viðbætur, PHP/React-vefforrit og hraðvirkar WooCommerce-verslanir. Við vinnum í fjarvinnu með áherslu á notagildi og traustan kóða.
is.localText: {location} — starfssvið: {sector}. Við hönnum lausnir sem bæta {workflow}. Þarfir notenda og vinnuferli ráða tæknivalinu.
is.approachText: Dæmi um verkefni fyrir {location}, ekki staðhæfing um unnið verkefni hjá viðskiptavini þar:
is.pluginsText: Gutenberg-einingar, ACF-reitir, samþættingar og einföld stjórnunarverkfæri án óþarfa viðbóta.
is.appsText: React/PHP-stjórnborð, gáttir, reiknivélar, bókanir, skýrslur og farsímavænar samþættingar.
is.ecommerceText: Flóknar vöruskrár, afbrigði, B2B-verð, afhendingarreglur, greiðsluferli og hraði.
is.d1: Skýr markmið, efnisuppbygging og mælanlegt ferðalag viðskiptavina
is.fa1: Nei. Við getum unnið í fjarvinnu. Fundir á staðnum eru samkomulagsatriði; síðan gefur ekki til kynna skrifstofu þar.
is.faq2: Getið þið bætt núverandi WordPress eða WooCommerce?
is.fa2: Já. Við skoðum kóða og afköst og þróum markvissar viðbætur eða samþættingar án ónauðsynlegrar endursmíði.
is.ctaText: Segðu okkur frá kerfinu, vandanum og markmiðunum. Við leggjum til áreiðanlega lausn.
is.remote: Fjarþjónusta; engin staðhæfing um skrifstofu á svæðinu.

locations.name: United Kingdom
locations.insight: A single storefront can reach several UK delivery zones, while an agency website may need separate pathways for service enquiries, recruitment and recurring customers. We plan the content architecture and order journey around those different intentions rather than launching pages that look the same.
locations.example: A multi-region catalogue with shipping classes, clear quote requests and reporting for the back-office team.

locations.name: London
locations.insight: London businesses often coordinate complex services across several teams and audiences. A fast WordPress editing workflow, a reliable customer portal and clean CRM hand-offs are useful when content, approvals and customer enquiries move quickly.
locations.example: A role-based client portal connected to service enquiries, documents and a clear approvals workflow.

locations.name: Milton Keynes
locations.insight: Milton Keynes has a strong mix of distribution, technology and regional service operations. Teams benefit when product data, quotations and internal job statuses can be managed without moving between disconnected spreadsheets.
locations.example: An order-status dashboard linking website enquiries to stock, delivery and customer updates.

locations.name: Northampton
locations.insight: Independent Northampton businesses need websites that are easy to manage after launch, not only attractive on day one. Trade services, local shops and growing online catalogues can benefit from better mobile enquiries and checkout rules that reflect how work is actually delivered.
locations.example: A mobile-first service website with photo-led project pages, quote requests and a simple lead inbox.

locations.name: Coventry
locations.insight: Coventry engineering suppliers and specialist service firms frequently have more detailed products than a basic brochure site can explain. Structured product attributes, technical documentation and practical lead forms can make a catalogue useful to procurement teams.
locations.example: A searchable technical-parts catalogue with specification filters and supplier enquiry forms.

locations.name: Birmingham
locations.insight: Birmingham brands may serve retail customers, wholesale accounts and professional buyers from the same website. A clear product structure, dependable payment flow and different account permissions can avoid duplication in the sales process.
locations.example: A WooCommerce shop with B2B account pricing, delivery rules and smarter catalogue navigation.

locations.name: Peterborough
locations.insight: Peterborough service teams often balance planned visits with urgent requests. A customer journey that explains availability, captures site information and produces reliable job records can reduce manual calls and missed details.
locations.example: A maintenance booking and field-reporting app with appointments, photos and printable reports.

locations.name: Northamptonshire
locations.insight: Across Northamptonshire, many businesses cover several towns rather than a single high-street address. Their sites need practical service-area information, useful examples of work and enquiry forms that collect enough detail for an accurate first response.
locations.example: A regional service site with town-level coverage information and structured estimates, without pretending to have offices in every town.

locations.name: Warwickshire
locations.insight: Warwickshire blends independent services, specialist manufacturers and visitor-facing organisations. Teams can keep updates manageable with tailored WordPress blocks for pages, projects, staff and offers rather than a costly all-purpose page builder.
locations.example: A lightweight custom WordPress plugin for reusable service, case-study and enquiry sections.

locations.name: Leicester
locations.insight: Leicester retailers and suppliers can have wide ranges of colours, sizes, bundles and seasonal stock. Clear variant management and fast category browsing help buyers find the right item without filling the site with near-duplicate pages.
locations.example: A product catalogue with variation swatches, intelligent filtering and stock-aware delivery information.

locations.name: Cambridge
locations.insight: Cambridge research and education organisations often need precise information architecture, accessible interfaces and secure workflows. A custom web app can connect forms, learning content and data exports without making an ordinary content page complicated.
locations.example: An accessible member dashboard with learning resources, permissions and reporting exports.

locations.name: Baltic States
locations.insight: Latvia, Lithuania and Estonia are neighbouring but distinct markets, with different languages, customer expectations and delivery setups. A regional digital product needs deliberately translated content and market-specific rules, not three identical pages with changed flags.
locations.example: A cross-border e-commerce architecture with Latvian, Lithuanian and Estonian content, currencies and delivery configuration.

lv.insight: Latvijai, Lietuvai un Igaunijai ir atšķirīgas valodas un patērētāju vajadzības. Viena e-komercijas platforma var apvienot kopīgu katalogu, vienlaikus atstājot atsevišķu saturu, piegādes izvēles un maksājumu plūsmas katram tirgum.

lt.insight: Latvijos, Lietuvos ir Estijos rinkos skiriasi kalba bei apsipirkimo įpročiais. Bendra e. prekybos sistema gali turėti vieną produktų katalogą, tačiau skirtingus pristatymo ir atsiskaitymo pasirinkimus kiekvienai šaliai.

et.insight: Läti, Leedu ja Eesti ei ole keele ega tarnekorralduse poolest ühesugused turud. Ühine e-kaubanduse tehniline alus võib toetada eri tõlkeid, tarnevalikuid ja makseprotsesse ilma sisu dubleerimata.

locations.name: Latvia
locations.insight: Latvian businesses may serve local customers and visitors or partners from elsewhere in Europe. Readable Latvian-first journeys with optional additional languages can improve trust while keeping maintenance simple for a small team.
locations.example: A Latvian-first WordPress website with bilingual service pages and custom lead-management tools.

lv.insight: Latvijas uzņēmumiem bieži nepieciešams saprotams saturs latviešu valodā ar iespēju apkalpot arī klientus no ārvalstīm. Pielāgots WordPress spraudnis var apvienot pakalpojumu pieprasījumus, klientu pieteikumus un satura administrēšanu bez liekas sarežģītības.

locations.name: Riga
locations.insight: Riga combines independent creative businesses, professional practices and growing software teams. A reusable content design helps editors publish clear service information while technical add-ons handle multilingual forms and lead routing.
locations.example: A custom WordPress plugin for multilingual service pages, team content and searchable case studies.

lv.insight: Rīgā līdzās tradicionālajiem uzņēmumiem darbojas dizaina studijas, konsultanti un tehnoloģiju komandas. Šādām organizācijām noder rediģējamas pakalpojumu lapas, daudzvalodu pieteikumu formas un centralizēta saziņa ar klientiem.

locations.name: Liepāja
locations.insight: Liepāja businesses working with visitors, accommodation and local experiences need an easy path from discovery to enquiry. A lightweight multilingual calendar or booking workflow can fit better than a complex marketplace integration.
locations.example: A bilingual visitor-service site with clear availability, booking enquiries and mobile directions.

lv.insight: Liepājā tūrisma, viesmīlības un pieredzes pakalpojumi bieži jāparāda ātri un saprotami arī mobilajā telefonā. Vienkārša rezervēšana, sezonas informācija un divu valodu saturs var būt lietderīgāks par sarežģītu platformu.

locations.name: Lithuania
locations.insight: Lithuanian shops expanding to nearby markets need product pages that remain consistent as languages, delivery methods and taxes vary. Clear checkout logic and edited translations make the shopping process easier to understand.
locations.example: A multilingual WooCommerce storefront with market-specific checkout and delivery options.

lt.insight: Lietuvos e. parduotuvėms, plečiančioms veiklą Baltijos regione, reikia nuoseklių prekių duomenų, aiškių pristatymo pasirinkimų ir kruopščiai išversto turinio. Patikimas WooCommerce pagrindas leidžia valdyti skirtingų rinkų taisykles vienoje sistemoje.

locations.name: Vilnius
locations.insight: Vilnius software, consulting and service companies often need to move beyond generic lead forms. Structured onboarding, client documentation and secure self-service can reduce repeat administrative work as a team grows.
locations.example: A client onboarding portal with project requests, document access and an activity history.

lt.insight: Vilniuje dirbančioms technologijų ir konsultacijų komandoms dažnai prireikia daugiau nei kontaktinės formos. Klientų registracija, dokumentų peržiūra ir užklausų istorija gali sumažinti pasikartojantį administracinį darbą.

locations.name: Kaunas
locations.insight: Kaunas distribution and manufacturing businesses benefit from technical catalogues that serve both sales staff and customers. Product specifications and quote requests work best when editors can update them without developer support.
locations.example: A B2B parts catalogue with faceted search, request-for-quote workflows and product data imports.

lt.insight: Kauno logistikos ir gamybos įmonėms svarbu greitai pateikti techninius duomenis pirkėjams. Katalogas su filtrais, specifikacijomis ir užklausų funkcija padeda pardavimų komandoms ir klientams rasti tinkamus sprendimus.

locations.name: Estonia
locations.insight: Estonian teams frequently expect digital processes to be direct, clear and reliable. A small but well-integrated app can connect a public website to back-office workflows without forcing staff to re-enter information.
locations.example: A compact React and PHP operations dashboard connected to a structured content website.

et.insight: Eesti ettevõtted hindavad selgeid ja töökindlaid digitaalseid protsesse. Avaliku veebilehe sidumine halduse, tellimuste ja aruandlusega vähendab andmete korduvat sisestamist ning aitab tööd paremini jälgida.

locations.name: Tallinn
locations.insight: Tallinn digital product teams value fast prototypes that can become maintainable production applications. Clear component boundaries, accessibility and measurable page performance matter as much as the first demo.
locations.example: A lightweight SaaS dashboard with configurable roles, exports and mobile-friendly navigation.

et.insight: Tallinna tehnoloogiaettevõtetele on oluline, et prototüübist saaks hästi hooldatav rakendus. Selge arhitektuur, ligipääsetavus ja mõõdetav jõudlus aitavad hoida toote kasutatavust ka kasvades.

locations.name: Tartu
locations.insight: Tartu education, research and community organisations often publish materials with several authors. Useful editing permissions, accessible documents and a clear content taxonomy help people find resources after they are published.
locations.example: An education portal with custom WordPress blocks, course resources and editorial roles.

et.insight: Tartu haridus- ja teadusasutustes avaldatakse materjale sageli mitme autori koostöös. Sisuroolid, lihtne struktuur ja kättesaadavad dokumendid aitavad õppematerjale pikemalt kasutada.

locations.name: Nordic Countries
locations.insight: Nordic markets share high expectations for usability but are not interchangeable. Language, currency, tax and checkout preferences must be checked market by market before a business expands across borders.
locations.example: A multi-market commerce blueprint with Swedish, Danish, Norwegian, Finnish and Icelandic content paths.

sv.insight: De nordiska marknaderna har höga krav på användbarhet men olika språk och köpprocesser. Ett gemensamt tekniskt upplägg måste anpassas för varje marknads valuta, leveransvillkor och innehåll.

no.insight: De nordiske landene har felles forventninger til kvalitet, men språk og kjøpevaner varierer. En god flermarkedsbutikk bør planlegge valuta, leveringsvalg og tekster for hvert land.

da.insight: De nordiske lande stiller lignende krav til digital kvalitet, men har forskellige sprog, valutaer og leveringsmetoder. En fælles platform bør derfor have markedsspecifikke indstillinger.

fi.insight: Pohjoismailla on paljon yhteisiä laatuodotuksia, mutta kielet ja verkkokaupan käytännöt vaihtelevat. Monimarkkinaratkaisu tarvitsee omat toimitus-, maksu- ja sisältövalinnat.

is.insight: Norðurlönd hafa sameiginlegar væntingar um gæði en tungumál, gjaldmiðlar og afgreiðsla eru ekki eins. Sameiginleg lausn þarf að taka mið af hverjum markaði.

locations.name: Sweden
locations.insight: Swedish e-commerce brands need transparent product information, well-organised categories and dependable purchase journeys. Customisation should simplify recurring operations rather than introduce fragile dependencies.
locations.example: A WooCommerce shop with filtered collections, product bundles and integration-ready order events.

sv.insight: Svenska e-handelsföretag behöver tydlig produktinformation, välordnade kategorier och smidig kassa. Anpassningar bör förenkla det dagliga arbetet och undvika onödiga tillägg som kan göra webbplatsen långsam.

locations.name: Stockholm
locations.insight: Stockholm service brands and digital teams can gain from combining a polished marketing site with clear customer self-service. The key is keeping fast public pages independent from heavier account features.
locations.example: A fast WordPress front end backed by a separate secure client portal and reporting tools.

sv.insight: Stockholms tjänsteföretag kan kombinera en snabb och tydlig marknadswebbplats med säker självservice. Genom att skilja den publika presentationen från tyngre kundfunktioner går det att behålla god prestanda.

locations.name: Gothenburg
locations.insight: Gothenburg industrial and logistics businesses may need to share specifications, quotations and shipment updates with trade customers. Small focused integrations often solve this better than an entirely new enterprise platform.
locations.example: An account-based trade catalogue connected to pricing sheets and order-status data.

sv.insight: Göteborgs industri- och logistikföretag behöver ofta dela specifikationer, offerter och orderstatus med företagskunder. Riktade integrationer kan ge stor nytta utan att byta ut hela affärssystemet.

locations.name: Norway
locations.insight: Norwegian service companies operating across dispersed areas need well-structured mobile workflows and clear customer communication. Easy-to-use reporting matters when teams work away from a central office.
locations.example: A mobile maintenance tool with offline-friendly capture, visit status and branded PDF reports.

no.insight: Norske servicebedrifter som dekker store områder, trenger tydelig planlegging og gode mobile arbeidsflater. Enkel registrering av oppdrag og rapporter gir bedre oppfølging når medarbeidere jobber ute hos kunder.

locations.name: Oslo
locations.insight: Oslo consultancy and specialist service firms need content that clearly explains what they do and the next step for a client. Flexible WordPress components can support case studies, expertise pages and appointment enquiries.
locations.example: A professional-services website with reusable case-study blocks and lead qualification forms.

no.insight: Konsulenter og tjenesteleverandører i Oslo trenger nettsider som gjør kompetansen enkel å forstå. Fleksible WordPress-blokker kan støtte fagartikler, caser og henvendelser uten tungvint redigering.

locations.name: Denmark
locations.insight: Danish design-led organisations often want fewer, stronger page patterns rather than endless visual options. A restrained component library can keep accessibility, branding and editing quality aligned.
locations.example: A custom Gutenberg and ACF component set with consistent typography and marketing templates.

da.insight: Danske designvirksomheder ønsker ofte færre, stærke skabeloner frem for mange individuelle løsninger. Et gennemtænkt bibliotek af Gutenberg- og ACF-komponenter kan forenkle redigering og fastholde ensartet design.

locations.name: Copenhagen
locations.insight: Copenhagen direct-to-consumer businesses can benefit from clear product storytelling paired with efficient shopping flows. The balance is to keep editorial presentation rich without slowing checkout on mobile.
locations.example: A brand-led WooCommerce storefront with fast media, editorial product layouts and tailored checkout.

da.insight: Virksomheder med direkte salg til forbrugere i København har brug for både gode produktfortællinger og en hurtig mobil checkout. Et skræddersyet WooCommerce-design kan kombinere indhold og funktion uden at gå på kompromis med hastigheden.

locations.name: Finland
locations.insight: Finnish industrial suppliers often need precise information, helpful filtering and content that works in more than one language. Searchable specifications can reduce email back-and-forth before a quotation.
locations.example: A product and documentation library with technical filters, downloadable details and enquiry capture.

fi.insight: Suomalaiset teollisuustoimittajat tarvitsevat selkeitä tuotetietoja, tarkkoja suodattimia ja monikielisiä esitteitä. Hyvin suunniteltu katalogi vähentää tarjouspyyntöihin liittyviä turhia sähköposteja.

locations.name: Helsinki
locations.insight: Helsinki B2B software and service companies need fast public websites and dependable application experiences. Connecting analytics, customer onboarding and support views can make a growing product easier to operate.
locations.example: A React-based customer workspace with role permissions and clear onboarding steps.

fi.insight: Helsingin B2B-ohjelmisto- ja palveluyritykset hyötyvät nopeasta julkisesta sivustosta ja selkeistä asiakasnäkymistä. Analytiikan, perehdytyksen ja tuen yhdistäminen voi helpottaa kasvavan palvelun hallintaa.

locations.name: Iceland
locations.insight: Icelandic visitor services need pages that remain useful on mobile connections and explain booking conditions clearly. Seasonal content and multilingual enquiry journeys can be more valuable than visual effects that slow the first view.
locations.example: A lightweight experience-booking website with seasonal availability and practical visitor information.

is.insight: Íslensk ferðaþjónusta þarf hraðar og aðgengilegar síður sem útskýra bókunarskilmála skýrt. Áríðabundið efni og fjöltyngdar fyrirspurnir geta verið gagnlegri en stórar hreyfimyndir sem hægja á opnun síðunnar.

locations.name: Reykjavík
locations.insight: Reykjavík visitor-facing companies benefit from concise local information, accessible mobile layouts and straightforward language switching. Helpful content should answer the key questions before the visitor makes contact.
locations.example: A multilingual visitor-service website with booking enquiries, travel information and fast image delivery.

is.insight: Fyrirtæki í ferðaþjónustu í Reykjavík njóta góðs af hnitmiðuðum upplýsingum, liprum farsímaviðmótum og skýrri tungumálaskiptingu. Gestir eiga að finna svör áður en þeir senda fyrirspurn.
